title: Booking emails state the time in the booker's own time zone

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: the picker shows times in the viewer's zone, but every email formats in the Space's zone (bookingTimezone). A booker in New York reads 'Tue 9:00 AM PST'. Fix: store the zone the browser reported at booking (space_bookings.booker_time_zone, additive) and use it for the booker's mails; the owner's mails keep the Space zone.

DONE 2026-11-23: the picker sends the browser's zone (Intl resolvedOptions) with a member or guest booking; cleanBookerTimeZone keeps only a real IANA zone of at most 64 characters and the insert saves it in space_bookings.booker_time_zone (migration 20270346350000, additive, with a length check). A before-insert trigger copies the zone onto a reschedule. The booker's confirmation, hold, reminder and cancellation mails format in that zone; the owner's mails keep the Space zone. Fail-soft: before the column exists the insert retries without it and the mails fall back to the Space zone.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
